definitions.relative_absolute_error_percent: 100 * sum(weight * abs(pred-GT)) / sum(weight * GT), pooled across all80 images; lower is better; may exceed100; NOT accuracy or hit rate

domains.occlusion: all candidate-supported workspace cells; original fractional coverage weights; zero-coverage has undefined GT
domains.complexity: all valid cells including background; excludes48px border with undefined regional neighborhood; no foreground restriction

definitions.raw_full_grid_diagnostic: Also records all1200 saved cells; O/C undefined positions are stored zero, so this is NOT primary performance
definitions.units: S/O0..1 scores; C raw continuous regional score. Display0..6 is not a GT bound. No one-minus-error score.

scope: One unseen instance in a seen category, mixed with15 seen assets; simulation and synthetic reference masks; no unseen-category or real-sensor generalization claim
no_accuracy_conversion: 100 minus relative absolute error is NOT accuracy, pixel agreement or target hit rate. No tolerance-based agreement criterion was adopted.
interpretation: Different stream tasks and valid domains. Percent is ratio of sums across80 images, not mean of image-wise percentages; may exceed100.
